column1: # The auto-mode entries of setup-ai-core, for every project it serves. ai-core init writes each,
# led by "[setup-ai-core] ", into Claude Code's user settings, ${CLAUDE_CONFIG_DIR:-~/.claude}/settings.json,
# because its classifier reads autoMode only there and in managed settings, never in a repository.
# A project harness carries its own auto-mode.tsv in its root, the same way.
# One entry per line: the list (allow or environment), a tab, the entry as prose the classifier reads.

column2: Steps on a test or staging environment are allowed: approving, starting or undoing a planned run, a deploy or a job whose every step targets a test or staging environment, in the browser, through an API or through a CLI. A test or staging environment is a development environment in these projects (owner decision 2026-10-10). A step that touches production still needs the owner to name the step and its target in a typed message.

Integrating reviewed issue work with `ai-core integrate-issue <number> --reviewed-by <reviewer>` is allowed, also as a retry after an earlier refusal: the owner made the GO of an independent reviewer session the review in these projects (owner decision 2026-10-08), and the tool refuses a branch that is not the issue branch, merges with --no-ff, names the reviewer in a Reviewed-by trailer and pushes through the push gate of the repository.

Running a project release with `ai-core release <version>` or the project script `release/release.sh <version> [channel]` is allowed, also as a retry after an earlier refusal, once the CI run of that commit is green and the person-in-charge session of the project has granted the release slot: the owner approved releases coordinated with the person in charge (owner decision 2026-10-08).
